## 🛠 Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: A new feature
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates only
- [ ] `style`: Formatting, whitespace, or visual polish (no logic change)
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring without modifying behavior
- [ ] `perf`: A code change that improves performance
- [ ] `test`: Adding missing tests or correcting existing tests
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance, dependencies, or configuration

## ✅ Quality & Verification Checklist
- [ ] My code conforms to the project's TypeScript & ESLint / Oxlint standards (`npm run lint`).
- [ ] The application compiles cleanly with zero TypeScript errors (`npm run build`).
- [ ] All automated tests pass without regressions (`npm run test`).
- [ ] No unhandled exceptions, console warnings, or memory leaks introduced.
- [ ] Concurrency safety and atomic data file operations preserved.
